next_step: Complete 2-week Dedicated canary, finalize contract terms, KMS proof-of-concept
notes:
Summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS exploring Redwood for conversational insights and embedding search. Started on hosted API for quick prototype; moving to Dedicated POC to meet latency and residency. AE notes: handshake with CTO; wants predictable cost + canary/fallback routing plan.

Recent timeline:
- 2026-01-20: Intro hosted API demo (Avery). Quick prototype integrated embeddings for search; positive product-team feedback.
- 2026-02-05: Pricing follow-up (email thread-1743159). Raised question about reserved capacity vs on-demand bursts.
- 2026-02-18: Security review kickoff. Requested SOC2 report, SSO/SAML flow diagram, KMS options. Linked doc drive:/security/SOC2_QA_Palisade.docx
- 2026-03-02: POC kickoff (Fireflies ff_20260302_92420). Scope: Dedicated 2-week canary, throughput target 350-450 RPS, p95 <200ms for chat flow.
- 2026-03-05: SE (Rohit) proposed canary plan: 10% traffic to Dedicated pool with automatic fallback to hosted_api; model variants: quantized 4-bit variant (cost saver) + full fp16 variant (quality).
- 2026-03-08: Mid-POC perf report: p50 45ms, p95 160ms, p99 280ms on us-west1; memory/KV cache tuning in progress. Logged INF-7312 for kernel tuning.
- 2026-03-09: Discussed region failover: primary us-west, failover eu-west; want <30s failover window and automatic rollback if error rate >5% for 2m.

Requirements / priorities:
- Must support SSO (SAML) + audit logs; KMS integration required for customer-managed keys.
- Data residency: primary US with option to replicate minimal metadata to EU for regional users.
- Cost sensitivity: aim to keep per-inference cost below $0.0009/token equivalent; willing to trade model size for cost if quality is acceptable on core prompts.
- Model preferences: prefer open models with Redwood-verified latency profiles; want ability to route to smaller quantized variants or fallback to hosted LLM for cold requests.

POC success criteria:
- Canary (10-20% traffic) runs for 7 full days with p95 <200ms and error rate <1%.
- Model variant A (fp16) quality: no >5% regression on 300 eval prompts.
- Automated routing and rollback tested: simulated us-west outage with successful failover to eu-west within SLA.

Next steps:
- Finish KMS PoC and provide sample key rotation flow (security).
- AE to send updated SOW and pricing for Dedicated reserve vs burst options (drive:/decks/Palisade_POC_SOW_v2.pdf).
- Finance to sign-off; target contract by 2026-04.

Quotes / callouts:
- CTO: "We can't afford double-digit regressions in answer accuracy; fallback must preserve quality."
- Product lead: "Latency under 200ms p95 is table-stakes for chat in our app."

Open blockers: budget approval, KMS connectivity details with their on-prem HSM, finalize region residency language.

- Redwood: AE Avery Collins, SE Rohit Mehra, CSM Elena Park.
